display_long_description:
# How high can you go?

Skybound is a free vertical VR platformer where the only 
direction is UP. Jump across floating platforms, race against 
the clock, and compete with players worldwide to claim your 
place at the top of the leaderboard.

Inspired by the "Only Up" genre - built for VR. Feel every 
jump in your body. Feel the height beneath your feet. Feel 
the rush of beating your record by just one second.




**🎮 HOW IT WORKS**


Jump, climbing and parkour your way upward. Fall - and start 
again. Each run you find faster routes and push your 
time lower.

Simple goal. Pure skill. Endless competition.


**✨ FEATURES**


- ⏱️ **TIME TRIALS** - PURE SPEED, PURE SKILL
   Race the clock on every run. Your best time posts
   to the global leaderboard automatically.

- 🏆 **COMPETITIVE GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS**
   See where you rank worldwide. One second faster = 
   one place higher. That's the whole game.

- ☁️ **VR-NATIVE HEIGHT EXPERIENCE**
   The sense of height in VR makes every jump feel real.
   Looking down has never felt so intense.

- 🌈 **FAMILY FRIENDLY**
   Bright, colorful, cartoon visuals. No violence, 
   no mature content. Safe for all ages.

- 🆓 **COMPLETELY FREE**
   No purchase required. No in-app payments.
   Download and play immediately.
